title: Batch native board and worktree discovery within one operation
goal: Vision: V-10. Unblock original Windows ACP 120 second process acceptance without weakening assertions, permission checks, ownership or freshness. Keep the exact native_board/worktree patch isolated on current main (the native freshness hook refuses a core57 commit); batch board configuration and immutable worktree metadata only inside each operation, keep fresh refs, claims, board stops and atomic pushes. Parent combines the Windows socket leaf and this minimal change into one shared compatibility revision, qualifies paired ACP and reconciles current public main. Measured baseline 182 Git starts with redundant config and absolute-path remote lookups.

reuse.searched: Reuse existing Git config, rev-parse, native board fail-closed checks and worktree ownership/provisioning. Trace contains 182 Git process starts, including repeated configuration discovery and absolute-path named-remote probes. No new Git parser, ownership model, ref cache or authorization layer.

limitations: Only one-operation repository/configuration discovery is batched. Board refs, owner files, stops, claims and compare-and-swap writes remain live. Original Windows ACP 120 second budget is unchanged; parent qualifies one combined shared core pin with the Windows socket leaf.
